data.title: 冰堂美智留 · 椿姬校舍天台水箱下的冰棒抢食
data.description: 烈日炎炎的高中教学楼天台水箱阴凉下，美智留身穿无袖水手服短裙豪爽地坐在铁管栏杆上，大口咬碎苏打冰棒，海风拂过短发，向你展示毫无防备的元气青春。

data.action: sitting perched casually on rooftop guardrail eating a double soda popsicle, swinging legs, bright sun-kissed smile with sparkling eyes
data.lighting: 盛夏暴晒强光与天台水箱投下的深蓝阴凉
data.promptProse: Michiru sits perched on the sunny school rooftop railing swinging her legs while chomping on an ice popsicle, smiling carefree in the summer sea breeze.
